import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create DataFrame
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': [None, None, None, 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Fill missing Sleep Disorder with 'No Disorder'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Create subplots
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration by BMI Category
plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df)
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration by BMI Category')

# Plot 2: Daily Steps by BMI Category
plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps', data=df)
plt.title('Average Daily Steps by BMI Category')

# Plot 3: Sleep Disorder Count
plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
sns.countplot(x='Sleep Disorder', data=df)
plt.title('Count of Sleep Disorders')

# Plot 4: Stress Level vs Sleep Duration
plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
sns.scatterplot(x='Stress Level', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Sleep Disorder', data=df)
plt.title('Stress Level vs Sleep Duration')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
